method: Laplace-smoothed multinomial naive Bayes; normalized margin; no hyperparameter search
limitations: Custom stratified split, not the official benchmark split.
Single partition, no external or prospective validation.
Confidence margin is not a calibrated probability.
Development target does not guarantee test accuracy.

No LLM or adversarial prompt-injection measurement.
